name: opper-media
description: Make images, video and speech in the conversation with your Opper account, with guided recipes for ads, product photos, explainers, episodes and voiceovers.

interface.longDescription:
Opper Media makes images, video clips and spoken audio from a few words in your conversation.

Describe what you want. Opper Media picks a suitable model, starts the job and shows the result in the chat: an image, a video player or an audio player. Videos render in the background, and the card updates by itself when the clip is ready.

What you can do:
- Create images from a description, in the shape you need: square, portrait or widescreen.
- Edit or restyle a photo you attach to the chat, or use your own photos as references.
- Make short video clips from a description, or animate a still image, including clips that start and end on frames you choose.
- Make a talking clip from a face and a voice, or extend a clip you already have.
- Turn a script into natural speech, and pick a voice by language, accent or gender.
- Get a transcript or a subtitle file from a recording or a video.
- Find your earlier results again, or ask which model suits a task, such as a clip with sound or a voice in a given language.

Guided recipes walk you through a whole piece: a product ad in one shot or several, a set of product photos, a creator-style clip with a presenter who speaks, a narrated explainer or a walkthrough of your own screenshots, an episode with the same characters, a film that follows your storyboard, a photo brought to life, a clip made longer, or a voiceover. You see a quick draft first and choose at every step.

Models: Opper Media offers a selection of image, video and speech models from several model makers, and you can ask for a specific model by name. Each model lists what it accepts, such as lengths, sizes and voices, and where it runs.

Your results: every result comes with a link that keeps working for 30 days, so you can open or download it later.

Account: Opper Media works with your Opper account. You sign in, or create an account, the first time you connect.

Please respect others: do not use Opper Media to depict a real person without their consent.

Opper Media is made by Opper Technology AB in Stockholm, Sweden.
capabilities: Generate video from text, images, audio or a clip
